violation_type.title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)
violation_type.typical_finding: The home daycare still needs to provide personnel file for primary caregiver and household members.

finding_variants.text: The home daycare still needs to provide personnel file for primary caregiver and household members.
The primary caregiver did not have a personnel file available for review.

Personnel record was not available for review during inspection.
A total of two employees were review.  One of the two employees were missing their employee file for licensing to review.
